subject: Lighthouse pilot: request for 2-week extension + implementation credit
messages:
From: Liu Chen <liu@lighthouse.health>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@lighthouse.health
Date: Sun, 7 Jun 2026 09:14:02 -0700
Subject: Request: 2-week pilot extension + implementation support credit

Hi Marissa,

Thanks again for the demo and the team’s fast help getting the pilot running. We hit a blocker this week when our data team discovered schema drift in the export feed; engineering estimates 10 business days to complete validation and re-ingest. That puts our planned evaluation window at risk.

Two asks from our side:
- Can Lighthouse get a 2-week extension on the time-boxed pilot (same throughput / SLAs) so we can finish validation?
- Given the unexpected engineering work on our side, would Redwood consider an implementation credit (applied to the pilot invoice or as engineering hours) to help offset the cost of your engineers assisting with initial ingestion and a short troubleshooting session?

We’re still very interested; this is about making sure we can evaluate quality under normal data conditions. Happy to get a quick call if useful.

Attachments: pilot-usage.csv (current token/endpoint sample)

Thanks,
Liu Chen
Senior Product Manager
Lighthouse Health
liu@lighthouse.health
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Liu Chen <liu@lighthouse.health>
Cc: David Kim <david_kim@redwood.ai>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 8 Jun 2026 08:02:45 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: 2-week pilot extension + implementation support credit

Hi Liu — thanks for the note and for flagging the schema drift. Sorry to hear you ran into that. We care a lot about making the evaluation representative, so we’re happy to work through options.

Short answer: yes, we can extend the pilot by 2 weeks. For the implementation assistance, here are two practical options we can offer immediately:

Option A (credit): 10% invoice credit applied to the pilot top-up (one-time credit).
Option B (hours): 8 hours of Redwood engineering time for hands-on ingestion/troubleshooting, to be scheduled this week or next; unused hours expire at pilot end.

Operational notes:
- We’ll need a minimal amendment to the pilot MSA to reflect the new end date and the applied credit/hours. I attached a short mutual action plan template we typically use. If procurement prefers an SOW-style redline, we can push a DocuSign amendment.
- If you want the hands-on support, Sergio (CC’d) can scope a 60–90 minute troubleshooting session + small follow-up. David will handle the commercial amendment.

Next steps (proposed):
1) Confirm which option you prefer (credit vs hours) by EOD tomorrow.
2) If hours, Sergio to propose times; if credit, David to issue amendment + invoice credit line.
3) We’ll execute amendment and flip the pilot end date.

I attached the mutual action plan draft and pulled the usage csv you sent into the shared thread.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0172
Attachments: Lighthouse_MUTUAL_ACTION_PLAN_v2.pdf
From: procurement@lighthouse.health
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, David Kim <david_kim@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 9 Jun 2026 10:11:03 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: 2-week pilot extension + implementation support credit

Hi Marissa / David,

Procurement here — thanks for the flexibility. A couple quick clarifying questions before we commit:

1) If Lighthouse takes Option B (8 engineering hours), will those hours be logged and reported back to our team with time and description? We need a short deliverable report for our internal auditors.
2) For Option A (10% credit), confirm whether the credit applies to the current invoice (pilot fee already paid on 6/1) or to any follow-on invoice/commit.
3) We will need an amendment that states the new pilot end date and includes a single-line statement about the credit/hours; can you provide a redlineable Word version?

If you can send a draft amendment and a brief statement about how the hours are tracked, we can get legal/procurement sign-off quickly.

Thanks,
Procurement Team
Lighthouse Health
procurement@lighthouse.health
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: procurement@lighthouse.health, Liu Chen <liu@lighthouse.health>
Cc: David Kim <david_kim@redwood.ai>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 9 Jun 2026 13:39:21 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: 2-week pilot extension + implementation support credit

Procurement — thanks, good Qs. Short replies below and next steps at the bottom.

1) Hours tracking: If you choose Option B, Sergio’s team will log time in our internal ticketing system and provide a one-page activity report (time, engineer, short notes, deliverables) within 48 hours of the work completion. We’ll include that report with the final pilot closeout.
2) Credit timing: Option A (10% credit) can be applied to the current invoice as a one-time refund/credit memo, or booked as a credit toward any follow-on order — whichever Lighthouse prefers. We typically issue a credit memo applied to the original invoice to keep bookkeeping clean.
3) Amendment: attached is a redlineable Word draft of the amendment (redwood-pilot-amendment-draft.docx). It includes:
   - New pilot end date (extend by 14 calendar days from the current end).
   - A single-line clause for the credit OR statement of hours (fill in per your selection).
   - A clause about hours reporting and expiration of unused hours at pilot close.

Next steps (lean path to sign):
- If you confirm Option A, we’ll generate a credit memo + attach amendment for signature.
- If you confirm Option B, Sergio will schedule the initial troubleshooting block and we’ll attach the hours log clause to the amendment.

David — can you please turn the attached draft into a DocuSign envelope once Lighthouse confirms which option you want? I’m happy to jump on a 20-minute call with Liu + Sergio if helpful.

Best,
Marissa
Attachments: redwood-pilot-amendment-draft.docx
From: Liu Chen <liu@lighthouse.health>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@lighthouse.health
Date: Wed, 10 Jun 2026 15:23:06 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: 2-week pilot extension + implementation support credit

Marissa — thanks for the quick turnaround and for the clear options. Lighthouse will take Option B (8 hours of engineering assistance). Please proceed with the amendment language that reflects the hours and the reporting requirement.

Next steps from our side: procurement will review the Word amendment and we’ll target signature by Thursday 6/11. Sergio — can you propose availability for a 90-minute troubleshooting session on Thursday or Friday (our engineers are Pacific time)?

Appreciate the partnership — looking forward to getting the feed validated and finishing the evaluation.

Best,
Liu
-- End of thread --
